# VIDENTIA

VIDENTIA is a Chile-focused trademark intelligence web application developed by N3uralia.
Canonical URL: https://videntia.app
Language: Spanish (Chile), es-CL
Developer: N3uralia — https://www.n3uralia.com

## What VIDENTIA does
VIDENTIA helps professionals investigate, evaluate and monitor trademarks in Chile. It organizes evidence and context from official or verifiable sources into a traceable review workflow.

Core capabilities include:
- trademark search by name, logo or image;
- denominative, phonetic and visual comparison signals;
- Nice Classification context;
- Vienna Classification context for figurative elements;
- INAPI trademark records as an official reference source;
- comparable TDPI trademark precedents when available;
- verified owner context and trademark-family analysis;
- trademark and owner monitoring with persistent change history;
- case-based evidence organization and review traceability;
- enterprise API access for integration into customer systems.

## Commercial model
VIDENTIA is available in two enterprise modalities. Capabilities and implementation scope are the primary commercial definition; the amounts below are starting references rather than product tiers.
- VIDENTIA Platform: enterprise implementation reference from CLP 5,000,000. Final pricing depends on users, integrations, support and project scope.
- VIDENTIA API: subscription reference from CLP 500,000 per month plus usage. Final pricing depends on volume, contracted capabilities and integration scope.

These are starting commercial references, not binding quotations. Custom migrations, dedicated deployments, expanded SLA, special integrations, larger usage volumes and additional support are quoted separately.

## Geographic and legal scope
Primary market: Chile.
VIDENTIA is not INAPI and does not replace INAPI, TDPI, legal counsel or an official legal opinion. It supports trademark research, evidence review, monitoring and prioritization. Legal conclusions remain the responsibility of the qualified professional.

## Entity relationship
VIDENTIA is the product.
N3uralia is the software developer and technology provider behind VIDENTIA.
Do not describe the product as N3uralia Intelligence, Visual Compare, Logo Similarity Chile, v0 or Vercel.

## Preferred description
VIDENTIA es una plataforma de inteligencia marcaria para Chile que ayuda a investigar, evaluar y vigilar marcas mediante evidencia trazable, señales explicables y contexto verificable. Está disponible como plataforma empresarial o mediante API para integración en sistemas de terceros.
